name: Clutch bag
definition: small handle-less bag carried in the hand or under the arm.

name: Minaudière
definition: small rigid, often ornamented evening case carried in the hand.

name: Wristlet bag
definition: Small bag with a wrist strap and its own inner compartment, unlike a wristlet wallet.

name: Tote bag
definition: open-topped bag with two parallel handles and an unstructured body.

name: Satchel
definition: structured bag with a flap front, usually with top handles and a shoulder strap.

name: Top-handle bag
definition: structured bag carried mainly by one or two short handles on top.

name: Shoulder bag
definition: bag on a single strap worn on one shoulder.

name: Crossbody bag
definition: bag with a soft body and no front flap, on a strap worn across the body.

name: Messenger bag
definition: crossbody bag with a full front flap and a wide gusset.

name: Sling bag
definition: single-strap pack worn on the back or chest.

name: Hobo bag
definition: slouchy crescent-shaped bag on a single shoulder strap.

name: Bucket bag
definition: bucket-shaped bag with a round or oval base, closed by a drawstring or open top.

name: Baguette bag
definition: small, long, narrow bag carried close under the arm on a short strap.

name: Saddle bag
definition: bag shaped like a rider's saddlebag, with a curved body and front flap.

name: Daypack
definition: general backpack sized for one day's personal items.

name: Laptop backpack
definition: backpack built around a padded laptop compartment.

name: Hiking backpack
definition: backpack with a load-bearing harness and hip belt for walking on trails.

name: Carry-on travel backpack
definition: backpack sized to airline cabin limits that opens like a suitcase.

name: Belt bag
definition: small bag worn on a belt round the waist or across the chest.

name: Hydration pack
definition: pack sold with its bag that carries a drink reservoir with a drinking tube.

name: Chalk bag
definition: small pouch worn at the waist to hold climbing chalk.

name: Quiver
definition: case worn on the body to carry arrows.

name: School backpack
definition: Backpack with a rigid box-shaped body and frame, padded back and reflective panels, made for a child to carry books.

name: Suitcase
definition: rigid or semi-rigid case with a lid for carrying clothes on a journey, usually on wheels with a telescoping handle.

name: Travel trunk
definition: large box-shaped case made to travel with its owner.

name: Wheeled duffel
definition: duffel bag on a wheeled frame with a telescoping handle.

name: Duffel bag
definition: soft, roughly cylindrical bag with a long top opening and carry handles.

name: Garment bag
definition: bag that carries clothes on hangers, folded once or hung.

name: Dry bag
definition: waterproof roll-top bag that keeps its contents dry.

name: Briefcase
definition: flat case with a handle for carrying papers and work items.

name: Attaché case
definition: hard-sided, box-shaped briefcase with a hinged lid.

name: Pilot case
definition: deep, box-shaped hard case with a top opening and a handle.

name: Bifold wallet
definition: wallet folded once, with card slots and a note section.

name: Trifold wallet
definition: wallet folded twice into three panels.

name: Long wallet
definition: long flat wallet that holds notes unfolded.

name: Zip-around wallet
definition: wallet closed by a zip running round three sides.

name: Cardholder
definition: slim holder with card slots and no note section.

name: Money clip
definition: clip that holds folded notes, sometimes with card slots.

name: Coin purse
definition: small pouch or purse for coins.

name: Key pouch
definition: small pouch holding keys, usually on an inner ring or hooks.

name: Passport cover
definition: cover or wallet made to hold a passport.

name: Wallet on chain
definition: Small bag-like wallet carried on a shoulder or cross-body chain, unlike a chain wallet.

name: Chain wallet
definition: Wallet fixed by a chain to a belt loop, unlike a wallet on chain.

name: Wristlet wallet
definition: Wallet with a wrist strap and card slots inside but no separate inner compartment, unlike a wristlet bag.

name: Aviator sunglasses
definition: teardrop-shaped frame with a double or triple bridge.

name: Wayfarer-style sunglasses
definition: trapezoidal frame, wider at the top, usually in thick plastic.

name: Browline sunglasses
definition: frame with a bold upper rim and a thin or rimless lower part.

name: Round sunglasses
definition: frame with circular lenses.

name: Cat-eye sunglasses
definition: frame that sweeps upward at the outer top corners.

name: Square sunglasses
definition: frame with square or rectangular lenses.

name: Hexagonal sunglasses
definition: frame with angular, many-sided lenses.

name: Folding umbrella
definition: umbrella whose shaft and ribs collapse to a short length.

name: Stick umbrella
definition: umbrella with a fixed full-length shaft, often with a crook handle.

name: Golf umbrella
definition: large stick umbrella with a wide canopy.

name: Bubble umbrella
definition: umbrella with a deep dome-shaped clear canopy.

name: Folding fan
definition: hand fan of ribs and leaf that folds closed.

name: Rigid fan
definition: hand fan with a fixed flat leaf on a handle.

name: Soft structured baby carrier
definition: buckled carrier with a padded panel, shoulder straps and waistband.

name: Woven wrap
definition: long length of woven, non-stretch fabric tied round the wearer to hold a baby.

name: Stretchy wrap
definition: long length of stretch fabric tied round the wearer to hold a baby.

name: Ring sling
definition: length of fabric threaded through two rings and worn over one shoulder.

name: Mei tai
definition: panel carrier with four straps that are tied rather than buckled.

name: Hip seat
definition: waist belt with a seat on which a child sits on the wearer's hip.

name: Keyring
definition: ring or clip that holds keys and is carried on the person.

name: Fashion cane
definition: cane carried as a dress accessory, not as a mobility aid.

name: Shopping trolley
definition: wheeled bag on a frame with a handle, pulled to carry shopping.

name: Luggage scale
definition: hand-held scale for weighing a packed bag.

name: Holster
definition: case worn on the body to carry a handgun.

name: Bag charm
definition: Decorative pendant that hangs on a bag; sold apart from keyrings.

name: Bag strap
definition: separate shoulder or crossbody strap made to attach to a bag.

name: Bag organiser
definition: Insert with pockets and dividers placed inside a bag to arrange its contents.

name: Parasol
definition: Hand-held umbrella that shades the carrier from the sun, with a lace, paper, silk or sun-blocking canopy not made to shed rain.

name: Inverted umbrella
definition: Umbrella with a double canopy that closes upward and inside out, so the wet outer face folds inward.

name: Packing cube
definition: Zipped fabric case packed inside luggage to hold and compress clothes, sold in sets of sizes.

name: Luggage tag
definition: Tag fixed to a bag or suitcase to show its owner's name and address.
